parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. It must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PublicKeyBody
parameters.description: The public key of the key pair.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the SSH key pair belongs.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags to add to the key pair.
